mdc.placeholder: Write the page in Markdown. Use the Insert menu for MDC components.

kinds.codeDescription: A block of code with colors.

note.label: Note
note.description: A blue box for extra information.

tip.label: Tip
tip.description: A green box with a useful tip.

warning.label: Warning
warning.description: An orange box for something to be careful about.

caution.label: Caution
caution.description: A red box for a risk or a breaking change.

callout.label: Callout
callout.description: A box with an icon and a color that you choose.

card.label: Card
card.description: A box with a title, an icon and a link.

card-group.label: Card group
card-group.description: Cards side by side in a grid.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: A numbered list of steps with headings.

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.description: Content in tabs, one tab at a time.

tabs-item.label: Tab
tabs-item.description: One tab of a group of tabs.

collapsible.label: Collapsible
collapsible.description: Text that the reader opens with a click.

field-group.label: Field group
field-group.description: A list of fields, for an API or a setting.

field.label: Field
field.description: One field with a name, a type and a text.

code-group.label: Code group
code-group.description: Code blocks in tabs, for example one per package manager.

code-collapse.label: Code that collapses
code-collapse.description: A long code block that the reader opens.

badge.label: Badge
badge.description: A small label inside a text.

kbd.label: Keyboard key
kbd.description: A keyboard key inside a text.

u-page-hero.label: Hero
u-page-hero.description: The big title at the top of a landing page.

u-page-section.label: Page section
u-page-section.description: A section with a title, a text and features.

u-page-feature.label: Feature
u-page-feature.description: An icon, a title and a short text.

u-page-card.label: Page card
u-page-card.description: A card for a landing page, with a title and a text.

u-page-grid.label: Card grid
u-page-grid.description: A grid that holds page cards.

u-page-c-t-a.label: Call to action
u-page-c-t-a.description: A box that asks the reader to do something.

u-button.label: Button
u-button.description: A button that links to a page.

preview.title: Page preview
preview.parseError: This block could not be read for the preview.
preview.blockError: This block could not show in the preview.
preview.notShown: This block does not show in the preview. It still works on the page.

editor.previewFailed: The page preview did not answer. You can still edit the blocks. Check that the site has the preview page, then try again.
editor.addBlockDescription: Pick a block to add to the page.
editor.emptyTitle: This page has no blocks yet
editor.emptyDescription: Add a text, a note or a card to start.
editor.nothingSelected: Click a block in the preview or in the list to change it.
editor.rawNote: This is the Markdown of the block. A change here replaces the block.
editor.languageHelp: For the colors, for example ts.
editor.tableNote: A table is a Markdown block. Edit the cells in the box. A visual table editor is planned.
editor.rawBlockNote: This block has Markdown that the visual editor does not change. You can edit it as Markdown.
editor.iconHelp: An icon name, for example i-lucide-rocket.
editor.parseErrorTitle: The visual editor cannot open this page
editor.parseError: The Markdown has a part that the visual editor cannot read. Use the Markdown editor to fix it.
